development.donor_rule: donors are other stations in the same network; shared-station components therefore also keep shared donor supervision inside one validation group

reserved.donor_rule: donors are other stations in the same network; shared-station components therefore also keep shared donor supervision inside one validation group

learning_curves: scripts/316 repeats training-network draws on development network labels. Those draws are not independence groups, and the interval across draws is training-sample variation on a fixed test panel, not a new-basin interval.
phase_residuals: scripts/317 scores the phase and air-temperature boundary on development networks. It remains a mechanism check for the hottest-30 endpoint. It is not evidence that the fitted risk score is necessary, and it is not recomputed here.
